title: Normalized derivation values generate affine conormal sections
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset S$ be affine opens with $U\subset f^{-1}V$. Set $A=\Gamma(X,U)$ and $R=\Gamma(S,V)$. Let $C$ be the actual diagonal conormal [def-sc-diagonal-conormal], and let $D:\mathcal O_X\to C$ satisfy the normalization of [lem-sc-diagonal-conormal-derivation-exists]. The $A$-submodule of $\Gamma(U,C)$ generated by $\{D_U(a):a\in A\}$ is all of $\Gamma(U,C)$. No differential comparison map or injectivity is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08S2 (lemma-differentials-diagonal), final affine calculation; Tags 01R3 (lemma-affine-conormal), 01KJ and 00RW; read online 2026-10-13

proof.text: Put A = Γ(X,U), R = Γ(S,V), B = A ⊗_R A and J = ker(μ:B → A). Restrict the diagonal to the affine open U ×_V U, where it is the closed immersion Spec A → Spec B. Restriction of the actual module-sheaf kernel is the ideal module of J. Compare tensor pullback with restriction through its adjunction, then apply affine conormal sections existence to this closed immersion. This identifies actual conormal sections on U with J/J² and identifies the tensor-pullback unit with the quotient class map. The generic closed-immersion conormal statement applies to the restricted ideal module, not directly to the global diagonal kernel; proving the restriction/adjunction comparison is part of this step.

The sectionwise kernel property supplies the ideal section representing 1 ⊗ a - a ⊗ 1. Apply the normalization IsDiagonalConormalDerivation to the two projections on U ×_V U. Under the unit-compatible quotient coordinates from step 1 this says D(a) is the class of that difference.

The differences 1 ⊗ a - a ⊗ 1 span J as an A-module (KaehlerDifferential.submodule_span_range_eq_ideal). The surjective class map J → J/J² takes this spanning set to a spanning set. Transport the span equality through the affine conormal section identification and use the value formula from step 2. This requires no injectivity theorem for the lifted derivation.

theorem diagonalConormal_affine_derivation_span (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (D : (diagonalConormal f).val.Derivation' f.pullbackPresheafToPresheaf)
    (hD : IsDiagonalConormalDerivation f D) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, U.1) (Set.range (fun a : Γ(X, U.1) ↦
      D.d (X := op U.1) a)) = ⊤
